title: Task params for oedis.handler.archive.compress
description: Configuration for compressing inbox files into archive files with the archive handler.

credential.description: Optional task-level archive credentials. The passphrase is used when a file entry does not provide its own passphrase.

passphrase.description: Optional passphrase used for encrypted zip or 7z output archives.

requests.description: List of archive creation instructions. Each item describes which inbox files to match and how the output archive should be written.

src_dir.description: Inbox-relative source directory to read from. Empty or omitted means ctx.inbox. Leading / is treated as inbox-rooted shorthand, and the resolved path must stay inside ctx.inbox.

include.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to include. Examples: '*.csv' or ['*.csv', '*.json']. When recursive is true, relative paths under src_dir can also match.

exclude.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to exclude after include matching. When recursive is true, relative paths under src_dir can also match.

format.description: Archive format to write. Use auto to write a zip archive; otherwise supported values are zip, tar, gztar, tgz, and 7z.

recursive.description: When true, walk subdirectories under src_dir. When false, only files directly under src_dir are considered.

delete_source_file.description: When true, delete each matched source file after the archive is written successfully.

dst_dir.description: Inbox-relative destination directory for the output archive. Empty or omitted keeps the handler's default behavior of writing the archive under src_dir. Leading / is treated as inbox-rooted shorthand, and the resolved path must stay inside ctx.inbox.

passphrase.description: Optional file-level passphrase. When provided, it overrides credential.passphrase for this archive output.
